    import re
    def word_case(match):

item.text:
Reconstructed all 57 verses in Urdu script and retained the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified line counts and stanza numbering, updated the title and text direction, and cleared the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Sallay Ala” as `صلِّ علیٰ` and “Alh-o-Alihi” as `علیہ و آلہ`.
